storage.label: Local saving
storage.nextStep: If unavailable, restart AXM FULL. Restore the foundation only from a verified backup.

export.label: Local export
export.nextStep: Open Marketplace & Deployment, then enter its Publish & Library foundation when you are ready for a real output.

files.label: Local files
files.why: Lets an explicit action read or write selected Workshop files.
files.nextStep: Choose the file action inside the workspace; no folder is scanned automatically.

runtime.label: Workshop runtime
runtime.why: Serves the local Hub and its tools.
runtime.nextStep: Restart AXM FULL if the local page stops responding.

gate.label: Permission gate
gate.why: Keeps declared actions behind the same controls for humans and machines.
gate.nextStep: Review the requested action in Permissions; do not widen access just to clear a warning.

guardian.label: Shell Guardian
guardian.why: Can stop supervised AI connections after a circuit-breaker event.
guardian.nextStep: Open AI Team, read the recorded reason, and resume only after review.

connectors.label: AI collaborators
connectors.why: Adds connected model collaborators; local work remains usable without them.
connectors.nextStep: Open AI Team to start or inspect a connector when you want one.

connectors-optional.label: Optional AI collaborators
connectors-optional.why: Adds AI help but is not required for this local workflow.
connectors-optional.nextStep: Continue locally, or open AI Team if you choose to connect a model.

network-optional.label: Optional internet intake
network-optional.why: Fetches outside data only after an explicit preview or import.
network-optional.nextStep: Open the workspace and choose its Preview or Import action when you want online data.

shared-engines.label: Shared engines
shared-engines.why: Provides common project, timeline, asset and evidence behavior.
shared-engines.nextStep: Restart AXM FULL. If still unavailable, run Verify before restoring files.

asset-vault.label: Asset Vault
asset-vault.why: Provides shared assets, provenance and licensing records.
asset-vault.nextStep: Open Publish & Library to inspect the library; importing remains explicit.

asset-hands.label: Shared Creation Hands
asset-hands.why: Matches declared screen, UI, game, print, fabric and physical target canvases to modular makers that can honestly honour their constraints.
asset-hands.nextStep: Open Creation Hands inside Studio or Asset Fabric. A MISSING_HAND or UNSUPPORTED_CANVAS result means the contract was preserved and no substitute was created.

plugins.label: Module registry
plugins.why: Lists installed modular tools without starting them.
plugins.nextStep: Open Dashboards to inspect visibility. Hidden does not mean retired.

backup.label: Workshop backup
backup.why: Creates local or public-safe packages for recovery and sharing.
backup.nextStep: Open Publish & Library and review the package contents before export.

game-runtime.label: Game runtime
game-runtime.why: Runs verified game packages and local multiplayer sessions.
game-runtime.nextStep: Open Game Forge, then choose Play-test or Game Hub explicitly.

workshop-direction.label: Workshop Direction
workshop-direction.why: Compiles a goal into bounded capability routes, exams, and visible missing-hand requests.
workshop-direction.nextStep: Open Workshop Direction and review the proposed plan; no goal is executed or queued automatically.

local-cc0-source-library.label: Local CC0 source library
local-cc0-source-library.why: Provides the rights-cleared reusable parts that PS2 Asset Forge can compose without an internet fetch.
local-cc0-source-library.nextStep: Open PS2 Asset Forge and inspect its local catalog and provenance before generating a candidate; do not substitute unknown assets to clear a warning.

three-webgl.label: Local WebGL preview engine
three-webgl.why: Renders the temporary 3D preview on this device without changing the exported asset claim.
three-webgl.nextStep: Open PS2 Asset Forge in a WebGL-capable browser. If preview remains unavailable, keep the asset unreviewed rather than exporting blind.

human-review.label: Human export review
human-review.why: Keeps temporary generated variants out of the library until a person deliberately chooses one exact candidate.
human-review.nextStep: Inspect the candidate in PS2 Asset Forge and approve only the exact artifact you intend to export; rejected previews are not retained.

creation-incubator.label: Creation incubator
creation-incubator.why: Generates bounded candidate families before taste or promotion decisions are made.
creation-incubator.nextStep: Open Asset Fabric and inspect its stopped or active heartbeat and candidate queue; nothing is promoted automatically.

body-pulse.label: Body Pulse
body-pulse.why: Shares this computer's bounded compute budget across heartbeat modules.
body-pulse.nextStep: Open Body Pulse to inspect pressure and leases. Pause or lower a heartbeat manually if the body is warm or busy.

optional-governance.label: Optional cross-perspective review
optional-governance.why: Allows separate human and machine seats to review a shared candidate without restricting solo use.
optional-governance.nextStep: Open Asset Fabric and inspect the selected constitution. Leave governance off when working solo.

child-receipts.label: Child experiment receipts
child-receipts.why: Lets the parent view prove what each independent experiment actually did.
child-receipts.nextStep: Open Evolution Foundry and inspect the child status and receipt links; the parent cannot repair or rewrite a child.

mirror-native.label: Mirror native experiment
mirror-native.why: Provides the bounded machine-native proposal and seam-review contracts used by the experiment.
mirror-native.nextStep: Open AI Team and inspect Mirror's current service status. Do not grant tool or world authority to clear a readiness warning.

local-world-exam.label: Local world exam
local-world-exam.why: Runs reproducible tests against disposable world challengers before any lineage decision.
local-world-exam.nextStep: Open the Governed Evolution Lab and inspect its exam and seed receipts; replace only the disposable test world if it breaks.

mirror-kernel.label: Mirror kernel
mirror-kernel.why: Provides Mirror's bounded local learner and explicit session boundary.
mirror-kernel.nextStep: Open AI Team and inspect Mirror before starting a study session. Keep the learner stopped when no session is intended.

identity-core.label: Attributed identity core
identity-core.why: Keeps each learner's sessions, artifacts and claims attached to the correct identity.
identity-core.nextStep: Open AI Team and verify the selected learner identity before enrollment; identities are never merged to remove a warning.

reasoning-shell.label: Reasoning shell
reasoning-shell.why: Provides inspectable analysis and judgement exercises without granting Workshop action authority.
reasoning-shell.nextStep: Open the AI Learning Forge and inspect the selected curriculum and boundaries before starting.

explicit-learner-opt-in.label: Learner opt-in
explicit-learner-opt-in.why: Requires a connected learner to be deliberately enrolled in an attributed study session.
explicit-learner-opt-in.nextStep: Choose the learner and curriculum in the AI Learning Forge. Do not enroll absent or unidentified models.

identity.label: Attributed identity
identity.why: Binds reviews, grants and secret access receipts to an explicit actor.
identity.nextStep: Open Secrets & Permissions and verify the actor before granting access; do not share or merge identities to clear a warning.

logs.label: Bounded operation logs
logs.why: Provides local evidence for diagnostics without exposing secret values or arbitrary files.
logs.nextStep: Open Diagnostics & Operations and inspect the allowlisted log view; export only after reviewing its contents.

local-network.label: Temporary local network handoff
local-network.why: Lets a paired phone or tablet send explicitly selected files over the current LAN.
local-network.nextStep: Open Device Handoff and start a short-lived session only on a network you trust; stop it when the transfer is finished.

project-room.label: Project Room
project-room.why: Provides planning, decisions and explicit project handoffs for learning work.
project-room.nextStep: Open Project Room to inspect or create the destination project; no learning record is moved automatically.

knowledge-canvas.label: Knowledge Canvas
knowledge-canvas.why: Provides sourced research, data and visual thinking surfaces used by learning projects.
knowledge-canvas.nextStep: Open Knowledge Canvas and choose the relevant project or import action explicitly.

ai-team.label: AI Team
ai-team.why: Provides optional attributed model collaborators and supervised agent handoffs.
ai-team.nextStep: Open AI Team to inspect identities and connector readiness; local learning remains usable without a connected model.

mirror-learning-forge-optional.label: Optional AI Learning Forge
mirror-learning-forge-optional.why: Adds an attributed machine-native learning surface without being required for human lessons.
mirror-learning-forge-optional.nextStep: Continue in Learning Lab, or open the AI Learning Forge only when a connected learner explicitly opts in.

publish-library.label: Publish & Library foundation
publish-library.why: Provides reviewed packaging, backups, assets and release evidence for deployment work.
publish-library.nextStep: Open Marketplace & Deployment and enter Publish & Library to inspect the exact artifact before packaging.

module-installer.label: Governed module installer
module-installer.why: Stages validated module bundles and applies only digest-approved updates with rollback evidence.
module-installer.nextStep: Open Installer & Updates to inspect the staged bundle; applying still requires review, a declared grant and exact confirmation.

review-inbox.label: Review Inbox
review-inbox.why: Records independent decisions against the exact digest of an artifact or module candidate.
review-inbox.nextStep: Open Review Inbox and inspect the candidate evidence; approval never applies the action automatically.

workshop-packager.label: Workshop Packager
workshop-packager.why: Creates the verified full package used as a recovery snapshot foundation.
workshop-packager.nextStep: Open Recovery & Rollback to create or inspect a snapshot; restore remains a separate confirmed action.

shared-physics.label: Shared physics services
shared-physics.why: Provides reusable bounded simulation engines and evidence contracts for spatial work.
shared-physics.nextStep: Open Spatial Studio and inspect the available adapter evidence; unavailable 3D dynamics remain honestly disabled.

qa-lab.label: Browser, LAN & Hardware QA
qa-lab.why: Records repeatable browser journeys and evidence from the actual viewport, network and controllers in use.
qa-lab.nextStep: Open the QA Lab, grant qa.run and run a fixed profile; capture device evidence separately in each target browser.

template-runtime.label: Template runtime
template-runtime.why: Preserves locked shells and makes missing, invalid or overflowing slot content visible before export.
template-runtime.nextStep: Open Template Runtime, render a preview and resolve every required or overflow warning before exporting the pack.

source-connectors.label: Governed source connectors
source-connectors.why: Fetches only declared official sources and binds reusable snapshots to citations and exact-digest review.
source-connectors.nextStep: Open Source Connector Hub, preview a query and promote it only after Review Inbox approves the same digest.

media-render.label: Media render service
media-render.why: Provides bounded final audio and video rendering with fixed codec profiles, cancellation and evidence.
media-render.nextStep: Open Media Render, grant media.render and inspect the completed output receipt before any release action.

living-world-state.label: Authoritative living world
living-world-state.why: Keeps one canonical owner and detects conflicts through expected revisions and snapshot evidence.
living-world-state.nextStep: Open Living World State Server, refresh the current revision and snapshot before a risky explicit patch or restore.

multiplayer-transport.label: Temporary multiplayer transport
multiplayer-transport.why: Provides short-lived controller seats without exposing the main Workshop to the LAN.
multiplayer-transport.nextStep: Open Multiplayer Transport on a trusted network, grant network.listen, start a short session and stop it after play.

world-adapters.label: Living-world adapter contracts
world-adapters.why: Lets games and physics emit revision-bound intents without acquiring world ownership or reset authority.
world-adapters.nextStep: Open the Adapter Kit, attach at the current revision and inspect the intent packet before applying anything through the world owner.

mirror-consent.label: Mirror observation consent
mirror-consent.why: Limits Mirror to selected facts and entity kinds at an exact world revision with a receipt.
mirror-consent.nextStep: Open the read-only adapter, grant a narrow short-lived scope and revoke it when observation is finished.

novelty-archive.label: Novelty and diversity archive
novelty-archive.why: Preserves distinct behavioral niches and structural proposals instead of converging one fixed genome.
novelty-archive.nextStep: Open Novelty & Diversity, use a recorded seed and inspect niche elites before choosing any proposal elsewhere.

release-channel.label: Signed public release channel
release-channel.why: Binds an immutable reviewed digest to an Ed25519 signature and explicit deployment receipt.
release-channel.nextStep: Open Public Release, stage an export, complete two-seat review, unlock the signing vault and deploy only to the intended channel.
